I know I just reported on an unconfirmed Google Search ranking update from this past Saturday, October 24th. But I am now seeing a larger spike in volatility, along with an increase in SEO community chatter around another unconfirmed update over the past 24 hours.
The update seems to have started about 12 hours ago, but Google hasn't officially confirmed anything yet.
This follows the unconfirmed updates I reported on past Saturday, October 24th, before that on October 20th & 21st and then before than on October 16th. And as a reminder, we had the Google September 2026 spam update start on Thursday, September 24, 2026 at around 12:00 pm ET and completed on October 8, 2026 at 4:37 am ET.
And yes, the Google tracking tools are struggling - even today, despite what some tools are issuing for statements.
